title: The empty chart outline is a grey dashed box with a chart icon
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. Browser: you use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with nothing in it: no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop).
